uncapped_widest50.rule: Per run, remove the 50 edges of the whole acyclic dev graph that alone support the most closure pairs. No labels, no checker.

thresholds.meaning: Mean of 3 runs on the holdout, against uncapped, same as experiment 3: false closure pairs removed >= 30%, true pairs lost < 10%, direct recall lost < 5%.

decisions.uncapped_widest50: Holds up only if all three thresholds pass on the holdout as labeled. Otherwise it is rejected. A pass does not add it to the pipeline: that needs the user's approval.
decisions.uncapped_vs_capped: Report only. The cap was removed by design direction, and no holdout result restores it.
decisions.no_retuning: Whatever the holdout shows is reported as is. No arm, rule, budget or threshold changes after scoring, and the holdout is not rescored.

rows.primary: Holdout as labeled: 159 concepts, direct and closure scored separately, intervals from resampling targets.
rows.sensitivity_hub_positives_removed: Same arms and comparisons without positives from the listed hub parents. Sensitivity only: it decides nothing.
rows.control_50_random: Random 50-edge removals, 500 draws per run, the experiment 3 control. Reported beside widest-50. It decides nothing.

excluded.source: Rejected on tune: no gain over uncapped or placebo.
excluded.pair_level_evidence: Not run: failed the offline gate, no arm exists.

caveats: The holdout is not fully unseen: the earlier all-dev diagnosis in scripts/diagnostics/ touched holdout concepts.
Widest-50 is post hoc: it came from a control added after seeing tune results.
The widest-edge wrong share (80% vs 65%) and the gold-limit repair row used labels from all dev, including holdout pairs, and were seen before widest-50 became a candidate.
The tune hub check revealed the holdout's label mix: 6 of 7 hubs are in it. No arm was scored there.
Some widest edges straddle tune and holdout, so holdout closure also depends on them. The budget of 50 is fixed and does not scale with graph size.
Gold is the merged either-dataset label, and independent human review is still pending.
